def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rs = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[i])]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 8 for i in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rs + [h], [-1] + cs + [w]
    for ri, (a,b) in enumerate(zip(rb, rb[1:])):
        for ci, (c,d) in enumerate(zip(cb, cb[1:])):
            markers = {grid[i][j] for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d) if grid[i][j] not in (0,8)}
            fill = 0
            if 2 in markers: fill = 2
            if 3 in markers: fill = 6
            for i in range(a+1,b):
                for j in range(c+1,d): out[i][j] = fill
    for ri, (a,b) in enumerate(zip(rb, rb[1:])):
        has3 = any(grid[i][j] == 3 for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(w))
        if has3:
            for i in range(a+1,b):
                for j in range(w):
                    if grid[i][j] != 8 and out[i][j] == 0: out[i][j] = 3
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rs = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[i])]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 8 for i in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rs + [h], [-1] + cs + [w]
    rows, cols = set(), set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] in (2, 3):
                ri = next(k for k,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rb,rb[1:])) if a < i < b)
                ci = next(k for k,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(cb,cb[1:])) if a < j < b)
                if grid[i][j] == 2: cols.add(ci)
                else: rows.add(ri)
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rb,rb[1:])):
        for ci,(c,d) in enumerate(zip(cb,cb[1:])):
            color = 6 if ri in rows and ci in cols else 3 if ri in rows else 2 if ci in cols else 0
            for i in range(a+1,b):
                for j in range(c+1,d): out[i][j] = color
    return out
PY
